pieces.description: Gold 6 ft 4-sided table throw with the logo on top and the business name on the front, both ends and the back.
pieces.mockup_prompt: A 6 ft folding table covered with a fitted 4-sided draped polyester table throw in plain solid gold with nothing printed on it, front panel facing the camera and reaching the ground, at an outdoor vendor market. Front panel unblocked. Landscape 3:2. Photorealistic commercial product photo shot on a full-frame DSLR, 35mm lens, natural daylight, true-to-life color, real fabric and material texture, soft realistic shadows, slight depth of field. Not an illustration, not CGI, not a 3D render. No text, no letters, no logos, no graphics, no watermark anywhere. No people's faces in focus.

notes: Logo is the customer's file, honeydrop-logo.svg, placed as is, not redrawn.
Side and back art is turned on the flat so it reads right side up when the cover hangs.
